how: Recreational drones under 7 kg can be flown legally at open sites such as Nam Sang Wai and Lower Shing Mun Reservoir, subject to no-fly zones and the CAD eSUA rules.

PolyU English Debate Club trains in British Parliamentary, Asian Parliamentary and Australasian formats and says its sessions are open to anyone; most other Hong Kong debate programmes are for students.
Splitdyboat runs live-action role-playing experiences themed on Hong Kong history, and university student groups such as Torn Label LARPG at CUHK also play.
